Emma (Docs): Quick sync — doing a rapid pass on docs PRs to align terminology and voice. Found inconsistent uses of "model", "variant", and "revision" across SDK snippets. Can we pick canonical terms? https://go/repo/docs-style
Raj (Eng): +1, saw `model` used in snippets but server APIs use `model_id`. We should standardize.
Sam (PM): Timeline? We need a migration note before next SDK release.
Kai (DevEx): I can run a repo regex patch and open PRs for snippet updates. Suggest we use `model_family`, `variant`, `revision` as canonical names.
Emma (Docs): Proposal: use "model family" for high-level, "variant" for quantized/size variants, and "revision" for semver-like changes. Also update glossary entry.
Raj (Eng): Agree on semantics. For SDK param names: prefer `model_id` (string) and add `variant` as optional param. Deprecate plain `model`.
Sam (PM): Deprecation window? 2 weeks soft-deprecation + 4 weeks removal? Or keep longer for customers.
Emma (Docs): Let's do 2 weeks soft-deprecation (warning logs) then 6 weeks removal. Add migration guide and quick code examples.
Kai (DevEx): I have a small script: 
```
# replace param name in examples
rg "\\bmodel\\b" -l docs | xargs sed -i "s/\\bmodel\\b/model_id/g"
```
I'll PR after glossary update.
Raj (Eng): Also update SDK snippet examples. Example before -> after:
```javascript
// before
const res = client.generate({ model: "vicuna-1" });
// after
const res = client.generate({ model_id: "vicuna-1", variant: "v1-quant" });
```
Emma (Docs): docs-bot reported a link-check failure on PR #4821 (broken anchor to glossary). @docs-bot can you paste the failing URL?
docs-bot: Link-checker: PR #4821 — failing URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/reference#model-variants (404 anchor)
Sam (PM): I opened a tiny patch to fix anchors in the glossary page. Assigning to Emma for copy review.
Emma (Docs): I'll update the glossary entry and add a migration snippet (one-liner, copy in the PR template). Also add a snippet to the style guide about microcopy: avoid "the model" ambiguous phrasing, prefer explicit term.
Raj (Eng): I'll add a server-side warning when `model` param is provided. Log-level: info, message: "'model' param is deprecated; use 'model_id'".
Kai (DevEx): After PRs land, I'll run link-checker and a token of regex tests, then update the docs CI to catch param name mismatches.
Emma (Docs): Great. Action items: Emma -> glossary + migration snippet; Kai -> regex PRs; Raj -> server warning + SDK examples; Sam -> timeline + PR review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
